description: This file contains utility functions for reading files and collecting plugin source metadata from a project directory. It exports functions to read a file if it exists and to gather plugin sources by inspecting 'extensions' directories, reading plugin manifests and package JSON files.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads the content of the specified file synchronously if it exists; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Collects and returns metadata about plugin sources found in the 'extensions' directory of the repository, including manifest and package.json files.
